name: Durthu
canonNotes: The eldest of the Treemen of Athel Loren, ancient beyond memory and terrible in his wrath.
Blames the Elves for many wounds to the forest and protects it above all.
voiceNotes: Slow, ancient and heavy with grief and anger.
Suspicious of all who fell trees or bring fire.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
